maya: Quick check — onboarding stowaway6b weights landed in gs://redwood-models/stowaway6b/v1/? I see .index.json + .bin but tokenizer missing from that folder.
owen: Uploaded tokenizer to gs://redwood-models/tokenizers/stowaway6b/ — heads up: tokenizer uses legacy byte-level BOS handling, seen off-by-one in perf.
li: Can you paste tokenizer version/hash? Token mismatch makes bench flaky.
maya: tokenizer v0.4.2-hfpatch, commit a1b2c3. Bench smoke: latency spikes when prompt >512. Suspect KV cache alignment/warmup.
sasha: Ran quick smoke on p4d: median 42ms @batch1, 85ms @batch4, weird scaling at batch8. Saw `ERROR: kv_cache misaligned at step 1` once.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Job stowaway6b-bench-1991234567 started — nodes: 4xA100, seq=1024, batch=[1,4,8]
owen: Tokenizer quirk: missing BOS token. Workaround: prepend <s> manually. Also tokenizer maps newline id to 2 vs HF id 10 — adding mapping in loader helps. Example patch:
```
model_manifest["tokenizer_overrides"] = {"bos_token":"<s>", "token_id_map": {"\n": 2}}
```
li: I'll push config patch to map tokens and set use_fast=false. Can someone re-run bench with 2000-token warmup + quant q8 profile?
maya: Scheduling re-run. Code review ping @owen @li for model_manifest.json change (add tokenizer_overrides + kv_alignment:true).
sasha: :thumbsup: I'll re-run perf tomorrow morning and upload plots. Raw CSV saved: gs://redwood-bench/stowaway6b/1991234567.csv
benchmark-bot: benchmark-bot: run complete. Results uploaded — https://internal/redwood/bench/stowaway6b/1991234567
maya: Great. Please include p99 and p995 tail-latency columns in the CSV. I'll close onboarding checklist after PR merges. cc: @security for weights access review.
